Use this to write on-brand captions BEFORE calling create_draft or schedule_post. Read-only; returns no secrets.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List posts across all platforms, newest scheduled first. Each row is one publication on one platform. tools.name: get_pipeline_summary
tools.description: High-level snapshot of the posting pipeline: active brand count, a status breakdown (how many scheduled/posted/failed/etc.), a per-platform breakdown, how many posts are due in the next 7 days, and the next scheduled date. Use for 'how's the pipeline?' style questions.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List connected platform accounts (channels) and their health: platform, account username, connected flag, posting-enabled flag, and token expiry. Use to check which platforms are wired up and whether any connection has expired. Never returns access or refresh tokens.

tools.name: post_performance

tools.name: content_queue
tools.description: The forward content pipeline: drafts awaiting approval first, then scheduled posts in publish order. Use to review what is queued before it goes out, and to find draft ids for schedule_post.

tools.name: campaign_summary
tools.description: Per-brand campaign rollup (brands are ViralCat's campaign unit): posted/scheduled/failed/draft counts, platforms used, next scheduled date, last posted date, and auto-post settings. Optionally scope to one brand_id.

tools.name: diagnose_failures
tools.description: Group failed posts by platform + normalized failure reason: counts, date range, affected brands, a sample raw error, a recoverable flag (retry_failed_posts can re-queue it) and a concrete suggested fix per group. Answers "what is broken and why" in one call. Read-only.

tools.name: preflight_check
tools.description: READ-ONLY: validate a post BEFORE it is scheduled or published, so a problem is caught up front instead of discovered as a failure afterwards. tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: WRITE (safe): create a DRAFT post for a brand. Drafts are never picked up by the publisher, so nothing goes live; a human approves in the dashboard or promotes it later with schedule_post. scheduled_date is a proposed slot (default: 7 days out).

tools.name: schedule_post
tools.description: WRITE (gated): queue a post for FUTURE publishing, at least 15 minutes out (immediate posting is not available over MCP). Either pass post_id to promote an existing draft, or brand_id + platform to create a new scheduled post. The publishing cron sends it at the scheduled time.

tools.name: cancel_post
tools.description: WRITE (safe): cancel a queued post, or move it to a new slot. Omit scheduled_date to CANCEL (status -> cancelled; the publisher ignores it). findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_brand_details" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_brands, get_brand_details, list_posts, get_pipeline_summary, diagnose_failures, preflight_check, cancel_post, refresh_post_metrics, upload_media · Private data: get_brand_details, list_connections, preflight_check, reconnect_platform, upload_media, create_media_upload · Public sink: list_brands, post_performance, content_queue, campaign_summary, preflight_check, create_draft, schedule_post, cancel_post, reschedule_post, refresh_post_metrics, reconnect_platform, upload_media, create_media_upload, update_brand.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_brands, get_brand_details, list_posts, get_pipeline_summary, diagnose_failures, preflight_check, cancel_post, refresh_post_metrics, upload_media · Private data: get_brand_details, list_connections, preflight_check, reconnect_platform, upload_media, create_media_upload · Public sink: list_brands, post_performance, content_queue, campaign_summary, preflight_check, create_draft, schedule_post, cancel_post, reschedule_post, refresh_post_metrics, reconnect_platform, upload_media, create_media_upload, update_brand

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
